save_quantized_model_as_mlx: save a quantized PyTorch model to MLX-compatible format for mlx-lm inference on Apple Silicon
pack_layer_for_mlx: pack a single quantized layer into MLX uint32 packed format with scales and biases
build_mlx_quantization_config: build the quantization dictionary for an MLX config.json with mixed-bit per-layer overrides
pack_weight_mlx: pack integer weights into uint32 tensors using MLX contiguous bit stream packing format
create_mlx_packed_layer: create an MLXPackedLayer module holding uint32 packed weights, float16 scales, and biases
